university.name: University of Lagos
university.dataNotes: Researched 2026-10-19. Faculties (19, effective 1 Aug 2025), semesters, the 100L-500L levels, hostel balloting rules and faculty/department election eligibility come from official unilag.edu.ng notices. UNVERIFIED / GAME DECISIONS: the matric number template — the proposed YYFFDDSSS shape (entry year, faculty, department, serial) is unconfirmed; game numbers carry a CL- prefix and fictional faculty/department matric codes so they can never be mistaken for official UNILAG matric numbers, the 600L level (inferred for 6-year MBBS/BDS), the 5-point CGPA scale, the continuous-assessment/exam weights, campaign and voting durations, and all department/programme lists beyond Computing and Informatics. Session dates are game dates. No real people are stored. Hall count differs by source (10/12/13/15); see each hostel's notes. WORLD: the Senate & Lagoon Front zone is a STYLISED, compressed game layout (not to scale; no verified site plan was used). Sofoluwe Park beside Senate House and Lagoon Front on the lagoon are sourced; other relative positions, and placing the 2001 Cafeteria (really in the New Hall Complex) in this zone, are game decisions. NPCs are fictional. Hostel room plans are game values.

admission.disclaimer: Simulated game admission only. This is not an offer of admission to the University of Lagos, and Campus Life does not create, verify or replace official UNILAG student records.

start.text: Fresher! Welcome to Akoka. How far? You look like person wey dey find somewhere.

options.label: Where can I go around here?

places.text: Senate House is the tall one straight ahead. Library on your left, 2001 Cafeteria on your right for food, and Lagoon Front at the back. Everybody ends up there.

options.label: Take me to one of them

tips.text: Carry your ID card everywhere, don't miss the first week of lectures, and when you're lost, ask. Nobody will laugh. Well, maybe small.

verification.notes: Fictional game character.

start.text: Good afternoon. Make sure you have your ID with you. Are you looking for somewhere?

senate.text: This is Senate House, eleven floors. Most administrative offices are inside. The park beside it is Sofoluwe Park.

verification.notes: Fictional game character.

start.text: My dear, you don chop? Jollof dey, amala dey, plantain still hot. Come inside!
